GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (3 Apr 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1594)
APO 500
3 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 17 Mar 47, file AG 000.5 (17 Mar 47) LS-R, (SCAPIN 1575), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one KOSAKA, Shigeru, L/Corporal, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said KOSAKA's name for the reason that he is no longer required. This name arrears as the seventh name on Page No. 2 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
